# anthropic_memory (Resource)

Manages one memory: a text document at a path inside a Managed Agents memory store. Use it to seed a store with reference material agents read, such as conventions or runbooks.

Agents can write to memories too. If an agent rewrites a memory this resource manages, the next plan shows the agent's content being replaced with the configured one. For a memory agents are meant to keep editing, either leave it out of Terraform or add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [content] }`. Updates carry the content hash Terraform last read, so an agent write landing between plan and apply fails the apply instead of being overwritten unseen.

`terraform destroy` deletes the memory. Its version history stays listable in the API.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_memory_store" "conventions" {
  name        = "conventions"
  description = "Team conventions the reviewer agent reads"
}

resource "anthropic_memory" "style_guide" {
  memory_store_id = anthropic_memory_store.conventions.id
  path            = "/style/go.md"
  content         = file("${path.module}/conventions/go.md")
}

# A memory agents keep editing: create it once and leave its content to them.
resource "anthropic_memory" "open_questions" {
  memory_store_id = anthropic_memory_store.conventions.id
  path            = "/notes/open-questions.md"
  content         = ""

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [content]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) UTF-8 text content, at most 102,400 bytes. An empty string creates an empty memory. Use `file()` to load it from disk.
- `memory_store_id` (String) Memory store to hold the memory (`memstore_...`). Changing it creates a new memory.
- `path` (String) Path within the store, for example `/conventions/style.md`. Must start with `/`, at most 1,024 bytes, unique within the store, case-sensitive, with no empty, `.` or `..` segments. Changing it renames the memory in place.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256 of `content`, as the API computes it.
- `content_size_bytes` (Number) Size of `content` in bytes.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Memory id (`mem_...`). Stable across renames.
- `memory_version_id` (String) Current version (`memver_...`). Changes with every content update.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the memory store id and the memory id, separated by a slash.
terraform import anthropic_memory.style_guide memstore_01ExampleStoreId0000000/mem_01ExampleMemoryId00000000
```
